name: Why not BC yet
place_line: Salmon River valley, Shuswap, British Columbia
summary: BC is where this problem started for us, but no BC field is modelled, scored or validated here.

reasons.title: No OpenET
reasons.text: No field-scale measured water use to check our crop-water model against.

reasons.title: No field-soil API
reasons.text: No SSURGO equivalent; drainage and water-holding capacity would be guesses.

reasons.title: One station per valley
reasons.text: Too few weather stations to check satellite rain and ET.

reasons.title: Crop labels since 2011 only
reasons.text: AAFC Annual Crop Inventory is shorter than the US Cropland Data Layer (2008-).

limits_line: BC is out of scope; transferability is a claim to test, not a result.

next_step.label: Next step: BC data stack for a future version
